title: [応用] 複合インデックスの基本を身につける
statement: 藩士向けSaaSのタイムラインでは SELECT * FROM messages WHERE tenant_id = 42 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50; が頻繁に実行されます。tenant_idで絞り込み、その中をcreated_at順に読める複合インデックスを作成してください。名前は自由です。
starterSql: CREATE TABLE messages (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL);
solutionSql: CREATE TABLE messages (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id INTEGER NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX idx_messages_tenant_created ON messages(tenant_id, created_at);
checkSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pragma_index_list('messages') il WHERE (SELECT group_concat(name, ',') FROM pragma_index_info(il.name) ORDER BY seqno)='tenant_id,created_at') AS ok;

benchmark.query: SELECT * FROM messages WHERE tenant_id=42 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50;
